verdicts.reason: A keeps the product can, and its headline and CTA have clear hierarchy. But the body copy is pushed above the headline at an unreadable size, which breaks the reading order. The headline is squeezed into a narrow column of about 11 lines, the badges and Sunset Sale tag are tiny and unreadable, and the logo is effectively lost. B drops the product image entirely and puts the legal line above the body copy. The Sunset Sale badge crowds the headline and logo, the badges and CTA are jammed together, and the missing-asset placeholder collides with the Small Batch badge, so the whole thing feels overstuffed even though its text is more legible.
